## Data Source

This analysis uses the [Gapminder dataset](https://www.gapminder.org/data/), licensed under [CC BY 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/).

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| message: false
#| warning: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gapminder)
```

## Data Preparation

```{r}
#| label: filter-modern-data
# Computational Chunk 1: Filter modern data post-1980
gapminder_modern <- gapminder |>
  filter(year >= 1980)
```

## Global Life Expectancy Trends

```{r}
#| label: fig-life-exp
#| fig-cap: "Life expectancy over time across continents (1980–2007)."
# Computational Chunk 2: Create life expectancy visualization
gapminder_modern |>
  group_by(continent, year) |>
  summarize(mean_lifeExp = mean(lifeExp), .groups = "drop") |>
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_lifeExp, color = continent)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Mean Life Expectancy by Continent", x = "Year", y = "Life Expectancy (Years)") +
  theme_minimal()
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
#| label: tbl-recent-stats
#| tbl-cap: "Summary of average GDP per capita and life expectancy in 2007."
# Computational Chunk 3: Compute summary table
gapminder |>
  filter(year == 2007) |>
  group_by(continent) |>
  summarize(
    avg_gdp = round(mean(gdpPercap), 2),
    avg_life_exp = round(mean(lifeExp), 1)
  )

```
